highlights.title: One kind of category rule
highlights.detail: Remembered categories are now category patterns. A pattern can also require a payment type, a direction or a recipient account. A rule with more conditions wins over a rule with fewer.

highlights.title: Checks on the Rules page
highlights.detail: Review lists the payees that only have a bank category or a guess, and a yellow count shows the guesses. Conflicts collects the category and payee rules that compete, and a red count shows them.
